text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Philippines President Fidel Ramos to visit Bahrain next week.
- Arab electricity conference to open in Bahrain on Monday. Delegates from 45 countries are expected to take part.
- A trade team from Italy to visit Bahrain next week.
- Bahrain ministry of commerce says 19 new firms with an overall capital of two million dinars have registered since January.
